Name: Highlight Empty Machines
Author: atravita
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6833]Highlighted Jars[/url], this mods colors empty machines so they're easier to spot. Works for every vanilla machine and also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url] machines. Additionally, dims "invalid" machines (machines in locations they don't currently work - ie casks in locations that are not valid for them, or PFM machines with location/weather/season restrictions.).

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
Simply delete from your Mods directory.

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.

[list=1]
[*]The coloration (both the EmptyColor and InvalidColor) can be set independently. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] installed, these will be color selectors. Otherwise, it'll be a text field where you can enter any color name from Microsoft's long list [url=https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.drawing.knowncolor?view=net-6.0]here[/url], an HTML color code starting with [font=Courier New]#[/font] (ie [font=Courier New]#FF0000[/font] for red), or list of numbers (ie [font=Courier New]255, 0, 0[/font] for red.)
[*]Every machine (including PFM machines) can be configured independently. If you have PFM machines, please load into a save before configuring - the PFM machines are not loaded until the save is.
[/list]
[size=5]Mods in screenshot[/size]
The mod machines in the screenshot are from the excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url] by Hadi!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Should be fine if installed for only one player in multiplayer.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. Tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]. Currently does not affect DGA machines; I'll add that in later.
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]
[*] [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/HighlightEmptyMachines/HighlightEmptyMachines/docs/Changelog.md]Changelog[/url]
[*] [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/HighlightEmptyMachines/HighlightEmptyMachines]Source code[/url]
[/list]
Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.

All donation points for this mod go to [url=https://www.againstmalaria.com/]Against Malaria[/url]. Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
